verifiedReplay.note: Measured by replaying the EXPORTED artefact through the JavaScript evaluator over the same geographic holdout used in training, with the conformal interval re-fitted on the calibration fold. These are the only figures that may be shown to users for this model. The numbers in `metrics` come from artifacts/evaluation_builtup.json, written by an earlier training run (evaluation generated_at 18:39:28 precedes model trained_at 18:51:12, which is impossible within one run because train.py writes the artefact before the registry) and they do not describe these trees.
